## Checklist

- [ ] `aree validate-study registry/studies/<STUDY_ID>.yaml` passes
- [ ] Sample sheet and FASTQ manifest generated by `aree fetch-samplesheet`, not hand-written
- [ ] FASTQ MD5s verified against the manifest before the run
- [ ] Workflow manifest(s) committed under `data/studies/<STUDY_ID>/`, with parameters, tool versions and input checksums
- [ ] Standardized result tables and the HTML report committed; no raw reads, `work/` or `results/`
- [ ] `qc_status` and `analysis_status` in the YAML reflect what was actually run
- [ ] Limitations and quality flags record anything that weakens the evidence (replication, phenotype definition, excluded samples)
- [ ] Curation tests in `tests/test_<study>_study.py` pin the decisions that are easy to erode later
- [ ] No edits to shared code, vocabularies or docs; those went in a separate PR
